candidate.disposition: confirmed defects; preserve as intermediate historical candidate, not qualified for publication

coverage.method: Independent offline source review plus parent source traces and bounded installed-package synthetic reproductions.

findings.title: Public bundles can disclose private archive payloads through directory-level visibility inheritance
findings.validation: The exact candidate CLI exported the synthetic private ZIP with visibility public while excluding its private sidecar and index node; command exited0.

findings.title: Configured generated outputs can overwrite native Git administration
findings.validation: The exact candidate CLI exited0 and replaced a synthetic .git/index with JSON during mdkg index. Separately, exact-candidate subgraph sync successfully replaced a synthetic parent .git/config with ZIP bytes. Identity operations also miss relocated inside-root Git administration in their lexical protected set; that topology route is source-validated only.

findings.title: Event append follows hard-linked files into non-owned peers
findings.validation: The exact candidate CLI exited0 and changed a synthetic outside-root hard-linked event peer; descriptor link count was2.

findings.title: Atomic graph-file replacement can widen restrictive filesystem permissions
findings.validation: Source confirms default-mode temporary replacement on task updates; no new runtime permission/ACL experiment was performed.

findings.title: Ancestor-directory swaps can escape pathname-based containment
findings.validation: Source confirms separate pathname admission and sink resolution; leaf no-follow does not anchor ancestors. No new race experiment was performed.

findings.title: Frontmatter boundary disagreement destroys document body or metadata during rewriting
findings.validation: Candidate6154e4ea accepted a task with a whitespace closing fence; preview was safe_to_apply with no blockers, exact-hash apply returned0, and a synthetic evidence paragraph before a later Markdown horizontal rule disappeared while the suffix remained. Preview itself preserved bytes. Installed format --headings --apply returned success but removed status and later fields for title review---notes. Preview was non-mutating but did not expose the destructive generated header.

findings.title: Diagnostic readers and storage walks bypass contained, bounded input admission
findings.validation: db index status --json followed a cache symlink to a small synthetic file outside the fixture root and included part of its contents in parse diagnostics. It returned process0 with ok:false. The outside file was unchanged. The unbounded /dev/zero path is source-supported only and was intentionally not executed. Parent traced fix cache/selected-goal, status changelog, and doctor root-walk paths in source; those additional routes were not dynamically executed.

findings.title: Legacy duplicate-ID repair rewrites unrelated identifier prefixes
findings.validation: Installed fix ids --base-ref HEAD --target task-1 --apply returned success and changed unrelated task-10 identity to task-20 and a reference to task-10 into task-20. All work occurred inside a synthetic Git fixture.

findings.title: Legacy work and capability linkage attribute evidence across workspace aliases
findings.validation: Installed work order status a:order.same reported b:receipt.only-b with success even though the receipt refers to b:order.same. Source confirms equivalent unqualified matching in capability work-order/receipt linkage.

nonsecurity.title: Correct generated command mutation and write path contracts
nonsecurity.disposition: confirmed package-contract blocker; static evidence, bounded effect tests required
